title: Enhancing Autonomous Driving Safety through World Model-Based Predictive Navigation and Adaptive Learning Algorithms for 5G Wireless Applications
abstract: arXiv:2411.15042v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Addressing the challenge of ensuring safety in ever-changing and unpredictable environments, particularly in the swiftly advancing realm of autonomous driving in today's 5G wireless communication world, we present Navigation Secure (NavSecure). This vision-based navigation framework merges the strengths of world models with crucial safety-focused decision-making capabilities, enabling autonomous vehicles to navigate real-world complexities securely. Our approach anticipates potential threats and formulates safer routes by harnessing the predictive capabilities of world models, thus significantly reducing the need for extensive real-world trial-and-error learning. Additionally, our method empowers vehicles to autonomously learn and develop through continuous practice, ensuring the system evolves and adapts to new challenges. translated_title: 通过基于世界模型的预测导航与自适应学习算法增强5G无线应用中的自动驾驶安全性
translated_abstract: 为了应对在不断变化且不可预测的环境中确保安全的挑战，特别是在当今5G无线通信世界中快速发展的自动驾驶领域，我们提出了Navigation Secure（NavSecure）。这一基于视觉的导航框架将世界模型的优势与关键的以安全为中心的决策能力相结合，使自动驾驶车辆能够安全地应对现实世界的复杂性。我们的方法通过利用世界模型的预测能力来预判潜在威胁并规划更安全的路线，从而显著减少了对大量现实世界试错学习的需求。此外，我们的方法使车辆能够通过持续练习进行自主学习和发展，确保系统不断演进并适应新的挑战。通过整合射频技术，NavSecure利用5G网络增强实时数据交换。
tldr: 提出NavSecure框架，将世界模型的预测能力与安全导向的决策机制相结合，并借助5G网络实现自动驾驶车辆的安全导航、威胁预判与持续自适应学习。
